_comment: Exercises a test finds by searching or walking the catalogue rather than by naming its id, so restore-test-fixtures.mjs (which only scans for 'NNNN' literals) does not pick them up. Listed here explicitly so the set stays complete and the reason is visible.
1197: search-typo.test.js expects first('sqat') to be 'squat' — the plain squat, not a dumbbell squat
0662: search-typo.test.js expects first('push ups') to be 'push-up'
0652: search-typo.test.js expects first('pull ups') to be 'pull-up'
